description: Update task properties. Support automatic name resolution: provide the task Name directly to the 'task' argument and it will be resolved to an ID. You do NOT need to search for the ID using other tools.

items.description: User ID (as string), email, or username

dueDate.description: Due date: unix ms or natural language.

listName.description: List containing the task. Helps resolve duplicate names.

name.description: New task name. Add emoji if appropriate.

parent.description: Parent task ID (preferred to convert to subtask), or null to remove parent.

parentListName.description: List name of parent task. Helps disambiguate parentName.

parentName.description: Parent task name. Resolved to ID if parent is missing.

priority.description: Priority 1 (urgent) - 4 (low), as string or number. Or null to clear.

startDate.description: Start date: unix ms or natural language.

status.description: New status (must be valid for list).

task.description: Task identifier (Name or ID). Use Name to skip searching.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

time_estimate.description: Time estimate: natural language ('2h 30m', '45m', '1.5h'), plain number (minutes), or null to clear.

name: update_task
